verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it supports 'replication configurations' alongside single-server setups, and it lists Kubernetes as a supported environment, so the capability is vendor-claimed. The evidence is only a one-line claim with no detail on how high availability actually works. Missing for 10: documented HA architecture (shared storage, session and queue handling, failover), step-by-step replicated deployment docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an HA deployment.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy a self-hosted instance in a replicated, highly available configuration

citations.quote: Provides flexible deployment options, supporting both single server setups and replication configurations.
Universally compatible with diverse operating systems and environments, including Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Kubernetes.
